notes.title: 🧺 MAJOR UPDATE IS HERE! 🎉
notes.content:
[b][h3]Hey, Laundry Legends![/h3][/b]

We’ve just dropped a huge update to Laundry Store Simulator — and it’s packed with fresh content you won’t want to miss! Check out what’s new:

✨ What’s in the update?

[b] 🔹 Max Laundry Rank boosted to 8
 🔹 Added 10+ new languages – play in your preferred language!
 🔹 Restocker now grabs boxes from outside too – smooth workflows incoming!
 🔹 Brand-new staff: shirt printer, shoe cleaner, carpet cleaner
 🔹 A new story to dive into
 🔹 New items & decorations to upgrade your space[/b]

[b]🛍️ Even better? The game is now 40% OFF![/b]
 Yup, it’s the perfect time to jump in or come back. This deal won’t hang around forever – don’t miss your shot to build the laundry empire of your dreams at a discount!

Update your game, try out the new features, and let us know what you think. We're excited to hear your feedback and see your new stores!

See you in the spin cycle! 🌀
Laundry Store Simulator Team

notes.title: Version 5.0.9
notes.content:
Small hotfix and some quality-of-life fixes

[list]
[*] Lori will now prioritize putting items that were placed previously in the empty shelf/vending machine if stock for that item exists on the storage racks
[*] Notification for carpet customer waiting to be served
[*] Improvements to notifications for obstacle spawning so that they always appear even if the player is currently in a UI screen
[*] Improvements to NPC behavior to help with customers and staffs getting stuck walking in place. Please let us know if this issue persists after updating to this version.
[/list]

Further fixes to common issues are still ongoing and will be released in a future update. New staffs for features that currently doesn't have one are also planned for a future update. Stay tuned!

notes.title: 🎉 New Update Version 5.0 in Laundry Store Simulator! 🎉
notes.content:
We’re excited to present the latest update packed with new features and improvements for your favorite game! 💖 Thank you for your support, feedback, and continued love for the game – it’s because of you that we can keep expanding the world of laundry!

[list]
[*] Maximum Laundry Rank increased to 7
[*] New feature: Carpet Cleaning! A satisfying cleaning system to help relax your day
[*] New app: Lootbox! Push your luck and get special decorations
[*] New app: Exclusive Store! Buy special items inside to further improve your laundry store
[*] New items
[*] Gamepad support!
[*] Bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

🤩 To celebrate, Laundry Simulator is now 25% off – starting today! It’s the perfect time to join or return to the game.
Thank you for being part of our community. Your passion and dedication inspire us to keep working hard. 💕

Time to get washing – see you in the game! 🚿✨
Laundry Store Simulator Team

notes.title: Version 2.1.0
notes.content:
Tis' the season! First of all, we want to say thank you so much to all of you for making this a great launch! We're beyond delighted to see your overwhelming support.

To celebrate this festive time of the year, we've prepared a small update for you. Discover a short, Christmas-themed story with a nice little reward at the end.

And of course, get ready for many more exciting updates coming in 2025!

Happy Holidays!

- New story about 2 boys, a reindeer and Santa
- New story about a poor DJ
- New obstacle: Bomber
- Fixed bugs

The issue with interactions getting blocked, usually after using the wrench, should also be fixed with this update. If you've experienced this before, please try out this update. If it still happens, you can report on the pinned forum thread here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3150440/discussions/0/595135660380149214/

notes.title: Release Date Announcement & Demo Update!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the official release date for Laundry Store Simulator is set for [b]December 9, 2024[/b]! Mark your calendars as you get ready to dive into the ultimate laundromat management experience!

In preparation for launch, we’ve also rolled out an updated version of the Laundry Store Simulator demo, now featuring support for additional languages. Here’s the list of all available languages:
[list]
[*] English
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] German
[*] Spanish - Spain
[*] Indonesian 
[*] Japanese
[*] Portuguese - Portugal 
[*] Polish
[*] Russian 
[*] Hungarian
[*] Korean
[*] Portuguese - Brazil
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Turkish 
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239280/Laundry_Store_Simulator_Demo/

Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback. We can’t wait for you to experience the full version of Laundry Store Simulator!

Stay tuned for more updates, and see you soon in the world of laundry and business management!

And don't forget to wishlist the game if you enjoyed the demo!
